It’s like I’m there, but I miss chunks of what they said.\n\nDoctor: Have you had this kind of trouble paying attention when people talk to you since you were a child?\n\nPatient: Yeah… I think so. But I don’t know if that’s “focus” exactly or just normal life getting in the way.\n\nSorry, what was the main part you were asking—reading and paperwork?\n\nDoctor: Do you often start a task and then get pulled off it before you finish?\n\nPatient: I mean… I guess sometimes?
